names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Ανίνας ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 18 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Анин чудотворац.“, with the rank word чудотворац left off, which this folder's `types` already carry. The heading is unusual on this source in opening on the name with no Свети or Преподобни before it, and it gives no city — Chalcedon is the body's first word — so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 18 марта ст. ст., «Анин Халкидонский, иеромонах», with the grade left off. The day's own line declines the name and gives no city, «Прп. Анина монаха».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Анина монаха.»

attestations.note: This calendar prints him twice, on 13 марта and again on this 18 марта, and his life page lists both: «Дни памяти: 13 марта, 18 марта». One row per church is the schema, so the row stands on 18/3 — the day this folder's Romanian and Serbian rows already use — and the 13 марта is recorded here; he does not render on it. The name link ranks him иеромонах where the day's line says монаха, and the life page has the bishop of Neocaesarea ordain him presbyter against his own will. The line gives no year and the day page prints no hymn for him.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 18 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Anin»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ανίνας ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The Greek calendar sets him on 16 March while the Romanian, which this folder already carried, keeps him on 18 March. The page's account is this folder's: the desert of Mesopotamia, the monk Maioumas, the taming of the wild beasts, the water carried from the Euphrates and the cistern filled at his prayer, the pack animal given him by Patrikios, bishop of Caesarea, and given away again to a poor debtor, ninety-five years in the one cell, a brotherhood gathered, a successor appointed, and his repose at a hundred and ten. It prints no hymn. The same site keeps an «Ανανίας ο Θαυματουργός» on 18 Μαρτίου whose page agrees with this life in some things and not in others; that is a separate question and no row is put on this folder for it.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.03.2026 (18. март ст. ст.) — „Анин чудотворац.“

attestations.note: The day's second and last entry, and plainly this hermit: a man of Chalcedon who renounced the world at fifteen and settled by the Euphrates, whose prayer filled a dry well, who healed the sick and tamed wild beasts, and whom both the other calendars already call the wonderworker. The Prologue keeps him on 18 March, agreeing with the Romanian row in this folder; the Greek row here stands on 16 March, which is where saint.gr prints him, and that disagreement is the two calendars' and is not touched. The entry gives no year of any kind — only that he was a hundred and ten years old when he died, which is an age and not a date — so the folder stays undated, as it was. Its heading opens on the by-name rather than on a rank word, which is unusual on this source: „Анин чудотворац.“, with no Свети and no Преподобни before it. Чудотворац is a rank word that this folder's `types` already carry, so the stored form is the bare forename. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
